description: The Django differences between ryo and the pinned Ruff 0.16.5 that Ruff parity accepts, each pinned by finding. verify_profiles.py --ruff-parity reads this file and refuses it for a request whose corpus digest (its file list and context manifest entries) differs, or when a rule is named twice. Any unmatched finding not named here, any named finding that no longer occurs and any end-position difference fails the run.

differences.reason: django/utils/translation/template.py writes in loops through out = StringIO("") (from io import StringIO). The pinned Ruff 0.16.5 treats only open(), io.open(), io.open_code(), os.open() and pathlib.Path(...).open() initializers as IO objects, so it omits these loops; ryo reports them under the certified reference discrepancy io-binding-4 in rules/FURB122/cases.toml, whose CPython 3.10 evidence (profiles/FURB122/evidence/independent-io-cpython310.json) shows io.StringIO is a TextIOBase with write and writelines.
